user.title: Poster Color
user.description: Lights take the colour of what is playing. Add one entry per room.

data_description.name: Shown as the device name, e.g. Living room.
data_description.media_player: The TV box or app that plays (Apple TV, Google TV, Jellyfin, Plex …).
data_description.area: The room the entities belong to.
data_description.control_lights: Off: only make the colour sensor, for use in your own automations.
data_description.color_lights: Follow the poster colour while something plays. Pick lights, devices or whole areas; only colour lights are used.
data_description.off_lights: Turned off while something plays, e.g. ceiling and floor lamps.
data_description.restore_delay: How long a pause or stop must last before the lights come back.
data_description.when: Dark: after sunset. Light sensor: below the chosen level (falls back to sunset if the sensor is unavailable).
data_description.fallbacks: Colour per app when there is no poster, one per line, e.g. YouTube: #ff2828
